screen.cText: The gremlin cries out in pain!

summary: The light scroll damages a visible gremlin after the room-lighting temporary-blindness pass, but JavaScript uses the generic pronoun because it does not restore vision before light damage.

source.branch: litroom() calls vision_recalc(2) for the redraw, marks a delayed full recalculation, then calls vision_recalc(0) before draining a nonempty gremlin list through light_hits_gremlin().

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:2598-2632: after the temporary blindness redraw and delayed-recalc flag, litroom() runs vision_recalc(0) when gremlins were collected, before light_hits_gremlin().
js/read.js:2048-2141: litroom() runs vision_recalc(2), sets vision_full_recalc, then immediately calls light_hits_gremlin() without the source-ordered vision_recalc(0).

nethack-c/upstream/src/uhitm.c:6425-6443 and js/uhitm.js:926-970: light_hits_gremlin() formats Monnam() from the monster visibility state; the current replay shows C naming the gremlin and JavaScript choosing "It".

The saved accepted v58 evaluation records screens 164/165, RNG 2536/2536, and cursors 165/165 for this recording; the local replay reproduces the same step-137 screen mismatch with all RNG and cursor entries matching.
